name: AXIS Historical Europe copper/salt candidate
existing_92_recipes: Unchanged, including post-1850 copper refinery, fishing harbour and post-1850 food processor

traditional_copper_smelter.input_policy: Every input is mandatory; stockpile incomplete batches
traditional_copper_smelter.historical_basis: Coal-fired Welsh process; game batch, not an assay or chemical mass balance

fish_saltery.input_policy: Both inputs mandatory; salt alone produces no food
fish_saltery.historical_basis: Salt curing of fish; abstract game batch, not a universal historical salt/fish ratio

meat_saltery.input_policy: Both inputs mandatory; salt alone produces no food
meat_saltery.historical_basis: Slaughtering and salt curing of meat, not canning. Abstract game batch, not a historical conversion or yield measurement.

salt_mine.implementation: Enable existing salt_mine only in Classic, using its existing Steeltown/Tropic salt-only output recipe; leave other economies unchanged
